g.g: <text style="font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Vu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1b2a49" x="35.712" y="25.92" transform="rotate(-0 35.712 25.92)">Every round, every seat, until three seats said the same thing

<text style="font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Vu Sans', 'Arial', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5a6473" x="35.712" y="47.232" transform="rotate(-0 35.712 47.232)">Three reviewers per round, each sealed from the others until it answers (from round seven the two browser seats kept their own thread across rounds, by owner ruling;

<text style="font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Vu Sans', 'Arial', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5a6473" x="35.712" y="61.056" transform="rotate(-0 35.712 61.056)">the seal is between seats). A round advances on evidence, never on a vote count.

<text style="font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Vu Sans', 'Arial', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5a6473" x="35.712" y="74.88" transform="rotate(-0 35.712 74.88)">A dashed inner border marks a report whose seal between seats was breached; it counted as technical evidence, never as an independent vote.

<text style="font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Vu Sans', 'Arial', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5a6473" x="80.352" y="312" transform="rotate(-0 80.352 312)">findings listed in the round record (light) and adopted before the next round (dark); "listed / adopted" marks the rounds whose synthesis declined some items; n/r = not recorded

<text style="font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Vu Sans', 'Arial', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5a6473" x="80.352" y="322.368" transform="rotate(-0 80.352 322.368)">r8: no browser-seat verdict file is banked; the round is recorded in aggregate as one GO-WITH-FIXES and two NO-GO

<text style="font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Vu Sans', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #22262e" transform="translate(80.352 501.125613)">Dashed box: build rounds 1 to 3 reviewed against a declared adversary that did not exist (an API caller on a system with no API). Cost: 3 rounds, 8 verdicts and one capability report, and a wiring-freeze mechanism built for that phantom <text style="font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Vu Sans', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #22262e" transform="translate(80.352 509.76)">and then reverted.
